title: Marketing Executive
description:
Marketing and Design Executive

Location: Lichfield

Salary: £32 - 35,000

Contract: Permanent, Full-Time

The Opportunity

Are you a creative, design-focused marketing professional with a passion for producing high-quality visual content?

Our client is an established supplier of industrial products, operating two recognised brands across a diverse customer base. They are looking for a talented Marketing and Design Executive with strong graphic design skills, a creative mindset and the ability to bring marketing ideas to life.

This is a hands-on creative role where design skills are essential. You'll take ownership of producing professional, engaging marketing materials across both digital and print channels, while helping to develop the company's online presence and support wider marketing activities.

Working closely with the marketing team and sales team, you'll have the opportunity to contribute your own creative ideas, develop engaging campaigns and see your work make a real difference to the business.

Key Responsibilities

Graphic Design & Creative Content
- Design and produce high-quality marketing materials, including brochures, flyers, product catalogues, price lists, promotional graphics and digital assets.
- Create visually engaging, professional content that strengthens the identity of two distinct brands.
- Use Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly InDesign, Photoshop and Illustrator, to produce polished, creative designs for both print and digital use.
- Maintain consistent branding, typography, layouts and visual standards across all marketing communications.
- Translate technical product information into clear, attractive and easy-to-understand marketing materials.
- Bring fresh creative ideas to marketing campaigns, product launches and promotional activities.

Digital Marketing & Social Media
- Design and publish engaging content across platforms for multiple brands.
- Develop creative social media campaigns using strong visual content and clear messaging.
- Create and manage advertising campaigns to support brand awareness, lead generation and sales.
- Maintain and update company websites, ensuring content, imagery and product information remain accurate, relevant and visually appealing.
- Ensure website content, social media and wider marketing activities work together to deliver consistent messaging.

Marketing & Sales Support
- Work closely with the sales team to develop marketing materials that support customer engagement and business development.
- Ensure marketing-generated leads are passed to the sales team within 24 hours.
- Support wider marketing projects and contribute ideas as part of a collaborative team.

What We're Looking For

Essential Skills & Experience

Creative & Design Skills
- Strong graphic design skills and demonstrable experience producing professional marketing materials.
- A creative background with a portfolio of design work demonstrating your ability across digital and print formats.
- Confident working knowledge of Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly InDesign, Photoshop and Illustrator.
- A good eye for design, including layout, typography, colour, imagery and attention to detail.
- Ability to work within established brand guidelines while bringing fresh, creative ideas to projects.
- Experience creating and preparing artwork for both print and digital applications.

Marketing & Organisational Skills
- Experience creating content and managing business social media accounts.
- Confidence updating website content and working with content management systems.
- Excellent written English and the ability to communicate clearly and professionally.
- Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects, priorities and deadlines.
- Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to producing accurate, high-quality work.
- Strong communication skills, with a professional, collaborative and proactive approach.

Desirable Skills & Experience
- Experience planning and managing social media advertising campaigns.
- Knowledge of WordPress and HubSpot.
- Photography skills, including capturing, editing and enhancing high-quality product and promotional imagery for digital and print marketing.
- Videography and video editing skills, with the ability to create engaging short-form videos, product demonstrations and promotional content for websites and social media.
- Familiarity with video editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro or After Effects.
- Experience producing marketing materials for technical, engineering or industrial products.
- An understanding of digital marketing performance, reporting and lead generation.
- Experience supporting sales teams through creative marketing campaigns and materials.

What's in It for You?

This is a fantastic opportunity for a creative individual who enjoys variety and wants to take real ownership of their work.

You'll join a supportive, close-knit team where your design skills and creative input will be valued. With the opportunity to work across two established brands, you'll be able to develop your experience, contribute new ideas and see the impact of your work on the company's continued growth.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Marketing Manager

Location: Staffordshire
Salary: Flexible DOE
Hours: 37.5 per week
B2 B Marketing Construction Landscaping Built Environment

Are you a B2 B marketer looking for a role where you can genuinely take ownership and have the freedom to shape how a business takes itself to market?

I'm working with a large, established landscaping business with a strong reputation across commercial landscaping, housing developments, grounds maintenance and horticulture.

They're looking for a Marketing Manager to take ownership of their B2 B marketing activity, working closely with the Managing Director and wider senior management team.

The Role

This is a hands-on role with plenty of variety.

You'll get out into the business, visit projects, work with operational teams and understand what clients are looking for - then turn that into marketing activity that raises the company's profile and supports both existing relationships and new business opportunities.

Day to day, you'll be involved in:
- Creating and managing B2 B content across LinkedIn, email and the website
- Visiting live and completed projects to gather content, photography and case studies
- Working with Contracts Managers and operational teams to understand upcoming projects
- Developing presentations, brochures, project sheets and sales collateral
- Supporting tenders, social value content and new business opportunities
- Managing email campaigns and the wider marketing calendar
- Supporting wider horticultural and nursery marketing activity
- Keeping the website and marketing materials up to date
- Working with senior management on marketing strategy and upcoming priorities
- Identifying opportunities to improve reach and strengthen the company's position in the market

There's already plenty happening across the business - they need someone who can find the stories worth telling and make sure they're reaching the right people.

About You

You'll need to be a proactive B2 B marketer who's comfortable taking ownership rather than waiting to be given a detailed brief.

You don't need to come directly from landscaping. Experience within construction, housebuilding, property, facilities management or another B2 B built-environment environment would be useful, but isn't essential.

You'll ideally have:
- Previous B2 B marketing experience
- Strong written and content creation skills
- Experience managing LinkedIn, websites and email marketing
- Practical graphic design capability, ideally Adobe InDesign and Canva
- The confidence to work directly with senior managers and operational teams
- A commercial mindset and an ability to spot opportunities
- Plenty of drive, creativity and initiative
- Full UK driving licence

We're open on level. You could already be operating as a Marketing Manager, or you may be a strong Senior Marketing Executive looking for the opportunity to step up and take more ownership.

Perks & Benefits
- 33 days' holiday including bank holidays
- Company pension
- Employee Assistance Programme
- Training and development
- Mileage reimbursement/pool vehicle for site visits
- Flexibility around start and finish times
- Some flexibility to work from home once established
- Direct exposure to senior management
- Plenty of autonomy to bring your own ideas to the role
- Genuine scope to develop the position and carve out your own role

This would suit someone who wants more than a narrow marketing role. You'll have the opportunity to get under the skin of the business, understand its clients and projects and have a genuine influence over how it's positioned in the market.

For more information or to apply, please contact Leo at MorePeople.

title: Media Relations Executive
description:
Senior Media Relations Executive

A role focused on media relations, press office and PR - without the usual social media and content marketing mix.

It's not often you find a role where you can really focus on what you do best. We're working with a global B2 B organisation that has grown significantly over the last decade, yet remains privately owned and family run. The owners take real pride in the business, know their people and genuinely care about the team. They're still involved, but thankfully, they're not the interfering type!

They're now looking for an experienced media relations professional to join their in-house marketing team and play a key role in raising the profile and protecting the reputation of the business.

Please note: this is a fully office-based position.

The Role

Reporting to the Group Marketing Manager, you'll take responsibility for developing and delivering media relations activity across a group of established businesses. It's a varied role combining strategic input with hands-on PR delivery, giving you the opportunity to shape communications activity and build relationships with the media that matter.

You'll develop proactive and reactive media plans, manage the press office and coordinate responses to media enquiries. You'll also write and oversee a range of PR materials, including press releases, thought-leadership articles, technical features, case studies, business updates and award submissions.

Building strong relationships with journalists, editors and trade publications will be central to your success. You'll identify stories from across the business, pitch compelling ideas to the media and secure quality coverage that enhances the organisation's profile.

You'll also monitor media coverage and competitor activity, identify potential reputational risks and support crisis communications when required. Working closely with colleagues across the business, you'll ensure messaging remains consistent and PR activity supports wider business objectives.

About You

You'll have solid experience in media relations or B2 B PR, excellent copywriting skills and the confidence to manage media enquiries and develop communications plans.

You'll understand the trade media landscape and ideally have established relationships with relevant journalists and editors. You'll be proactive in finding stories, comfortable taking the initiative and able to balance strategic thinking with practical delivery.

Experience in the construction or electrical sectors would be advantageous, as would knowledge of crisis communications and reputation management. A degree in PR, journalism or communications would be useful, but relevant experience is what really counts.

The Opportunity

If you enjoy PR but are tired of roles where media relations gets squeezed between social media calendars, content plans and everything else, this could be a refreshing change.

You'll be joining a successful international business that hasn't lost its family-run feel, where people matter and you'll have the opportunity to make a genuine contribution to its communications and reputation.

Interested? Apply today to find out more.
